title: Commander Question
description: One commander question (CQ): a single written question the commander puts to the pilot. The pilot never answers it directly, only through a pilot decision (XD). Filed by identifier with a dash, CQ-004.json.

kind.description: the word commander-question, which is what chooses this schema

id.description: this question's identifier, CQ, a dash and three digits, the same identifier the file is named for

name.description: one to three words the writer chose for the record's contents, appended to the file name after the id (CA-049)

date.description: the day the commander asked it, YYYY-MM-DD

session.description: the eight-character id of the session the question was asked in

status.description: open while no pilot decision answers it yet, answered once one does

question.description: the commander's own words, verbatim and never edited

refers.description: the identifiers this question concerns, a bracketed list, when it is asked against other commander records; absent when the question stands on its own. The old Rq, P, Or and De forms are accepted only until XD-005's citation sweep replaces them

answered_by.description: the pilot decision that answers this question, present once status is answered

brief.description: the surrounding transcript context: what prompted the question
